## Stop: do not submit this issue publicly

Use **Report a vulnerability** from the affected repository's **Security** tab.

Do not paste credentials, private keys, customer information, account exports,
or unredacted production logs into this form. If private reporting is not
available, contact an organization owner without disclosing exploit details in
public.
